disciplines.name: Работа с идеями и исследование
topic_descriptions: Materials about the early stages of product development focused on idea discovery, problem exploration, and research. This topic includes articles on identifying user and market needs, discovering opportunities, framing product problems, and shaping initial product ideas. It also covers methods and practices for product discovery, customer and user research, hypothesis validation, competitor and market analysis, customer development, interviews, MVP validation, and finding product-market fit. Relevant materials often discuss frameworks and methods such as JTBD, Opportunity Solution Tree, Value Proposition Canvas, Design Thinking, CustDev, MVP, PoC, PMF, problem interviews, solution interviews, usability testing, and other research or validation approaches used before full-scale design and development.

disciplines.name: Планирование
topic_descriptions: Materials about planning and steering product and project work: defining product vision and strategy, setting goals and success metrics, prioritizing initiatives, and translating strategy into concrete roadmaps and delivery plans. This topic includes articles on portfolio planning, project and program management, choosing the right methodology (Agile, Kanban, hybrid, Waterfall + Agile), organizing backlogs, aligning teams around shared objectives, and coordinating stakeholders and communication.

groups.name: Jira
topic_descriptions: Materials about using Jira, Atlassian tools, and related project management software for planning and execution. This topic includes articles on Jira workflows, board setup, sprint configuration, issue types and custom fields, native and custom integrations, best practices for managing projects in Jira, workflow automation, and connecting Jira to other tools in the development and planning process.

groups.name: Agile
topic_descriptions: Materials about Agile methodology, values, and practices in planning and project management. This topic includes articles on implementing Agile in teams, Agile philosophy and principles, applying Agile to software development, resolving conflicts in Agile teams, prioritizing Agile values, and putting Agile into practice in organizations.

groups.name: Kanban
topic_descriptions: Materials about Kanban for planning and flow-based work. This topic includes articles on Kanban boards, WIP limits, flow efficiency, evolving Kanban practices, using Kanban with remote and distributed teams, lessons learned from Kanban adoption, and Kanban in project delivery and planning contexts.

groups.name: Estimation
topic_descriptions: Materials about estimating work in Agile and project contexts. This topic includes articles on discovery estimation, estimation techniques such as story points and planning poker, estimation tools and spreadsheets, calculating and refining estimates, ranking and sizing backlog items, Agile estimation practices, and improving project delivery through better estimation.

groups.name: Budgeting
topic_descriptions: Materials about budgeting and financial planning in Agile and project contexts. This topic includes articles on Agile budgeting, budget planning, forecasting tips, staying on budget, funding iterations or value streams, and aligning financial planning with Agile delivery and project outcomes.

groups.name: Product Strategy
topic_descriptions: Materials about defining and executing product strategy. This topic includes articles on product strategy frameworks, e-commerce and digital product strategy, expert insights on building a strong strategy, positioning, growth strategy, and linking strategy to roadmap and execution.

groups.name: Roadmap
topic_descriptions: Materials about product and project roadmaps. This topic includes articles on strategic vs tactical roadmaps, roadmap planning and prioritization, stakeholder alignment and stakeholder intervention, data-driven roadmap decisions, working with senior stakeholders, the product owner role in roadmaps, and connecting roadmaps to product development and delivery.

groups.name: MVP
topic_descriptions: Materials about scoping and planning an MVP within the planning phase. This topic includes articles on defining MVP scope, brainstorming and trimming features for an MVP, prioritization for minimum viable product, wireframes and early design in planning, and deciding what to build first to validate with users.

groups.name: API
topic_descriptions: Materials about API design and management in software and product contexts. This topic includes articles on API principles, REST vs gRPC, API frameworks, performance trade-offs, API governance, API strategy, API management, API security, API documentation, API testing, API monitoring, and API integration with other systems and services.

disciplines.name: Разработка
topic_descriptions: Materials about software and product development: coding practices, development workflow, developer tools, and delivery. This topic includes articles on front-end and back-end development, e-commerce and web apps, data labeling and ML pipelines, fine-tuning LLMs, developer productivity, coding assistants, APIs (REST, GraphQL, JWT), DevSecOps and security, logging and observability, and data processing (e.g. Spark). It also covers process and methodology in development such as Kanban, Scrum, Agile retrospectives, and low-code or citizen development.

groups.name: Kanban
topic_descriptions: Materials about applying Kanban in software development. This topic includes articles on Kanban practices for development teams, reducing context switching and cognitive load, improving code quality through flow and WIP limits, and using Kanban boards and metrics in day-to-day development work.

groups.name: Scrum
topic_descriptions: Materials about the Scrum master role and Scrum in development. This topic includes articles on Scrum master best practices, servant leadership, avoidable mistakes, leadership skills for Scrum masters, growth path and career development, and becoming a transformation expert in Agile and Scrum contexts.

groups.name: Low-code
topic_descriptions: Materials about low-code development and citizen development. This topic includes articles on low-code platforms, building solutions with minimal coding, citizen developers, fast delivery with low-code, addressing talent shortages through low-code, and when to choose low-code vs traditional development.

groups.name: Agile
topic_descriptions: Materials about Agile practices in development, with focus on retrospectives. This topic includes articles on running Agile retrospectives, remote and distributed retrospectives, videoconferencing practices for retros, and tips for successful and effective retrospectives in development teams.

groups.name: Logging
topic_descriptions: Materials about logging in software development and operations. This topic includes articles on logging handlers, structured logging formats and practices, building logging pipelines, log aggregation and analysis, and best practices for logging in production and development environments.

groups.name: Spark
topic_descriptions: Materials about Apache Spark for data processing and development. This topic includes articles on Spark optimization, tuning performance, high-performance data pipelines, PySpark development, Spark architecture and best practices, and processing large-scale data with Spark.
